Summary: [PDP] an endless loading occurs when opening the selected items in the carts
Creator: Mohammad Abd El Rahman
Description:
h3. Impact

Medium

h3. Expected Results

User should be able to open the cart normally after adding some items and proceed to the checkout page.

h3. Actual Results

After adding some items into the cart and clicking on the cart button to view it and proceed, an endless loading is occurred.

h3. Steps to reproduce

# Go to [https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/|https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/|smart-link] 
# Add some items into cart
# Click on the cart button to view the selected items 

h3. Environment

Windows 10 \ WiFi

h3. Workarounds

User has to refresh the page after adding the selected items

Summary: [Password Reset] User can set a new password that is identical to the old password
Creator: Mohammad Abd El Rahman
Description:
h3. Impact

Low

h3. Expected Results

User should not be allowed to set a new password that is identical to their old one.

User should receive an appropriate message if entering the same old password.

h3. Actual Results

After the user enters a new password that matches the old one, the system proceeds to the home page without any rejection or error message.

h3. Steps to reproduce

# Go to [https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/|https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/|smart-link] 
# Prereq : User is already registered
# Click on Login button at the top of page
# Click on “Forget your password?” 
# Enter your registered account and click on the reset link from the email inbox
# set the new password to be the same as old password on “ Reset Account Password” page

h3. Environment

Windows 10
